title: Deer dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='30' ry='4' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <!-- legs dancing -->
  <rect x='36' y='68' width='6' height='20' rx='3' fill='#c07a3a' transform='rotate(-15 39 78)'/>
  <rect x='58' y='68' width='6' height='20' rx='3' fill='#c07a3a' transform='rotate(15 61 78)'/>
  <rect x='44' y='70' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#8a5320' transform='rotate(20 47 78)'/>
  <rect x='52' y='70' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#8a5320' transform='rotate(-20 55 78)'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='85' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a3410' transform='rotate(-15 34 87)'/>
  <rect x='62' y='85' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a3410' transform='rotate(15 66 87)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#d98a40'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f0b878'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='52' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#f5e6c8' transform='rotate(20 68 52)'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M40 50 Q36 38 42 32 L52 36 Q48 46 52 50 Z' fill='#d98a40'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='30' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#d98a40'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='33' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#f0b878'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='32' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#5a3410'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='28' r='2' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='42.7' cy='27.3' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d='M46 21 Q44 12 38 8' stroke='#a9713a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M44 16 Q40 14 37 15' stroke='#a9713a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 22 Q54 14 60 11' stroke='#a9713a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 17 Q59 13 62 14' stroke='#a9713a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='24' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f0b878' transform='rotate(-30 35 24)'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='24' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f0b878' transform='rotate(30 53 24)'/>
  <!-- raised arm/foreleg for dancing -->
  <rect x='30' y='50' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='#c07a3a' transform='rotate(45 32 58)'/>
  <rect x='68' y='50' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='#c07a3a' transform='rotate(-45 70 58)'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M22 20 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5 z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M78 34 l1.2 3 3 1.2 -3 1.2 -1.2 3 -1.2 -3 -3 -1.2 3 -1.2 z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M70 74 l1 2.5 2.5 1 -2.5 1 -1 2.5 -1 -2.5 -2.5 -1 2.5 -1 z' fill='#ffe066'/>
</svg>
